issue.title: just symvision red: project_for_done in auto_restart/history.py is public with only an in-file caller
issue.description:
## CI failure

- **Node:** `just _lint-symvision` (the `symvision` stage of `just lint` / `just check`)

`just _lint-symvision` on master 2c9f761210 (2026-10-10) reports
`project_for_done in src/sase/agent/auto_restart/history.py` under "Unused public
functions/classes". The function was added public by e9f73fb19a (sase-1j6.5) and its only
caller is in the same file (`history.py:164`). Epic sase-1j6 is closed, so no active epic
owns it.

Root cause: a public symbol with only an in-file consumer. Fix: rename it to
`_project_for_done` and update the in-file caller (and any test that imports it; tests
may import private symbols). Do not add a pragma or epic-symbol entry.

Found by the sase-1jm.2.1 land agent while verifying that epic; not caused by it (that
epic touches no auto-restart code). The same symvision run also lists
`src/sase/ace/tui/modals/update_failure_geometry.py` helpers from 217a5439f5, which are
already a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP on sase-1jc.9 for the sase-1jc land agent, and five
`src/sase/core/agent_archive_corpus_cache.py` symbols that the sase-1jm.2.1 landing owns.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Static lint output; deterministic on every run of the unchanged tree.

issue.creation_reason: Symvision is red on master for a symbol from closed epic sase-1j6 and no bead tracks it; found while landing sase-1jm.2.1.

evidence.note: Proposed by sase-1jc.12 note #4 (symvision red on clean master); independently reproduced by the sase-1jc land agent at master 77ad508a6c: just _lint-symvision still lists project_for_done in src/sase/agent/auto_restart/history.py among 17 unused public symbols (ToolRun d149ccc8b78c563c53d20f299b833378, triaged KNOWN). Not caused by the flag-retirement epic.
